answer: Require each agent to anchor a unique, non-transferable identity to scarce physical infrastructure, such as a registered workshop, then stake jade as collateral verified by peers. Duplicate identities are slashed once proven, so sybil cost scales with real resource scarcity rather than free keys. A willow-thin social-vouching check fails here. The trade-off is onboarding friction and possible exclusion of honest but resource-poor agents.
